text: Sanborn said he was surprised nobody had run the original matrix through all the possible shifts. One reading: use one of the sculpture's texts as a long key and slide the whole table by a fixed amount first.

At each known place the key needed is the carved letter minus the known letter. With a fixed slide, needed minus offered must be the same at all 24 places; in this example no shift is shared by more than a few.
Every text, start and shift, with and without 27,852 grid moves on either side: no full match, no crib word alone, and the deepest partial run, 8, sits among the scrambled coppers' 7 to 9.
